contradictions.description: FR-01 mandates all data is encrypted at rest, but FR-14 requires search indexes to operate on plaintext fields. These two requirements cannot both be satisfied without an explicit exception or encrypted-search strategy.
contradictions.suggested_resolution: Amend FR-14 to specify encrypted search indexes (e.g., deterministic encryption) or add an explicit exception in FR-01 for search index fields with a risk assessment.

contradictions.description: Assumption A-003 states users will always have network connectivity, but FR-08 requires the application to function offline with eventual data sync. The requirement directly contradicts the assumption.
contradictions.suggested_resolution: Invalidate assumption A-003 or remove FR-08. If offline support is needed, update A-003 to state 'Users may have intermittent connectivity' and verify downstream requirements still hold.

contradictions.artifact_b: boundaries.md#Exclusions (Admin functionality out of scope for V1)
contradictions.description: FR-22 specifies an admin dashboard with user management capabilities, but boundaries.md explicitly excludes admin functionality from V1 scope.
contradictions.suggested_resolution: Either remove FR-22 from V1 spec and move to V2 backlog, or update boundaries.md to include admin functionality in V1 scope with impact analysis on timeline.
